# Word-form fixtures

Public English Wiktionary definition API responses for lubisz, lubić, Hauses and Haus, and Polish lubić / German Haus MediaWiki parse responses, retrieved 2026-09-22. German Haus is trimmed to its source declension table and a minimal synthetic definition. Sources: https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lubisz, https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lubić, https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Hauses, https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Haus, https://pl.wiktionary.org/wiki/lubić, https://de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Haus.

© Wiktionary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0. Used as offline regression fixtures. Unmodified API data retains sense structure, including synonyms that must not be mistaken for inflection links.

Additional same-day fixtures cover English houses/house, went/go and French chevaux/cheval, mangeaient/manger. English REST data is trimmed to the tested language; French native pages are trimmed to the definition section (navigation/media/translation blocks removed). Sources follow the same edition `/wiki/{word}` URLs and licence above. `went` deliberately preserves the independent noun and both go/wend form links to exercise ambiguity handling.

`native-Ästhetik.json` preserves the German parse response from https://de.wiktionary.org/wiki/Ästhetik (same date/licence) for etymology extraction.
